verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal documents official SDKs for Android, iOS, JavaScript and React Native. An official GitHub terminal-js package installs via npm/yarn, and the docs include versioned SDK migration guides (5.0.0, 6.0.0) and a built-in simulated reader for SDK development. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the SDK developer experience specifically (community comments praise API integration generally, not the SDKs).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Terminal supports an API-based integration in addition to SDKs for Android, iOS, JavaScript, and React Native.
Use `npm` or `yarn` to install the Terminal JS module:
Learn how to migrate to version 6.0.0 of the Stripe Terminal SDK.
Stripe Terminal SDKs and server-driven integration come with a built-in simulated card reader, so you can develop and test your app without connecting to physical hardware.
